title: Graph-Based Heuristics for Minimum Constraint Removal in Cluttered Robot Motion Planning
description:
arXiv:2610.12609v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanoid and service robots operating in clut- tered human environments may encounter motion planning problems that are infeasible when all surrounding objects are treated as fixed obstacles. The Minimum Constraint Removal problem, which we refer to as MCR, addresses this situation by identifying the minimum number of constraints, such as movable objects, whose removal enables a collision-free path. However, computing an optimal MCR solution is NP
